messages:
From: Olivia Chen <accounts-payable@orchidtech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@orchidtech.com, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orchid Labs — entity rename and updated tax docs

Hi Marcus,

Quick note from the vendor side — Orchid Labs recently completed a corporate reorganization and changed from "Orchid Labs LLC" to "Orchid Labs Inc." as of 2027-08-15. Our EIN remains the same but the legal name on bank and corporate filings is now the Inc. entity.

I attached the certified Articles of Amendment and a signed W-9 reflecting the new legal name. We also have an IRS CP575 confirmation letter from when the EIN was initially issued — attaching that as additional verification.

Request: can Redwood switch the vendor master record and future POs to Orchid Labs Inc. (remit: Orchid Labs Inc., EIN: 12-3456789)? Also, we have three outstanding invoices submitted under the LLC name (PO #PO-4521). Would Redwood prefer we issue credit memos and re-submit on the Inc. name, or can finance accept the invoices as-is if the EIN matches?

Attachments: OrchidLab_W9_signed_20270910.pdf; ArticlesOfAmendment_OrchidLabs_20270909.pdf; IRS_CP575_Orchid_EIN_20270820.pdf

Thanks — Olivia

Olivia — thanks for sending these over and for the clear packet. A few quick items so we can move this through the vendor onboarding queue: 

1) Procurement needs a certified W-9 (we have that) and Articles of Amendment (we have that). Finance prefers an IRS-issued document (CP575 or equivalent) for EIN confirmation — you've attached that which is great.

2) Action for Procurement / AP: Kimberly — can you confirm whether we should create a brand-new vendor master for "Orchid Labs Inc." and a new PO series, or simply update the existing vendor master and reissue a PO that references the old PO number? Also flag any tax/legal gating items.

3) Olivia — please confirm whether Orchid prefers credit memos for the three outstanding invoices or if you want us to accept them under the EIN match and simply update remit details going forward. If you choose credit memos + reissue, we'll coordinate credits + new invoices.

Naomi: looping you for payments impact and any hold on #PO-4521.

If it's easier, happy to hop on a 15-min call — propose Mon 9/13 10:00am PT.

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Procurement Programs

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Olivia Chen <accounts-payable@orchidtech.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Orchid Labs — entity rename and updated tax docs

Thanks Marcus / Olivia — documenting procurement steps so everyone is aligned.

Procurement / Vendor Master checklist (what we need to change / verify):
- Certified W-9 showing current legal name (received: OrchidLab_W9_signed_20270910.pdf)
- Articles of Amendment (received: ArticlesOfAmendment_OrchidLabs_20270909.pdf)
- EIN confirmation (IRS CP575 attached) OR bank letter showing EIN on file (received: IRS_CP575_Orchid_EIN_20270820.pdf)
- Updated vendor contact + remit address + ACH details (Olivia, please attach ACH addendum if bank account changed)

Next steps / options for POs and invoices:
A) Create a new vendor master for "Orchid Labs Inc." and issue a new PO series. For the three outstanding invoices under PO-4521 (submitted under LLC name): vendor should issue credit memos for the old invoices; vendor re-submits invoices under the Inc. name with a new PO referencing the new vendor master. This is our preferred, clean accounting path.

B) If vendor requests, Finance can accept the three invoices as-is provided the EIN matches and the vendor signs a short attestation confirming the legal rename and that payments align with the EIN on file. This is faster but creates a vendor-name divergence in the ledger records; will require a note in the vendor file.

Please let us know which option Orchid prefers. If option A, Olivia, if you can push the credit memos and new invoices to AP by end of next week (9/17) we'll plan to route payments as soon as new vendor master + PO are live.

I have also attached a short vendor-docs checklist (vendor-docs-checklist.xlsx) to make sure we capture all artifacts.

Naomi — for payment holds: please confirm whether to hold payment on PO-4521 until new vendor master is created or allow payment under attestation (option B).

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Vendor Operations Manager, Procurement
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Olivia Chen <accounts-payable@orchidtech.com>

Hi Kimberly / Marcus — thanks for the clear options.

Orchid prefers option A (new vendor master, credit memos + reissue) to keep historical records aligned. We will:
- Submit three credit memos referencing the old invoice numbers by EOD 2027-09-16.
- Reissue the three invoices under "Orchid Labs Inc." once Redwood creates the new PO / vendor master.
- Upload ACH addendum to the Drive link you shared if we change bank details.

I've attached the notarized W-9 and Articles of Amendment already; the CP575 will be added to our Drive folder and I'll paste the link to the DocuSign envelope once legal finishes their signature routing.

If you need anything else for vendor setup, let me know — otherwise we'll target credit memos the week of 9/13 and reissued invoices after new PO is issued.

Best,
Olivia Chen
